en: A colorized historic postcard view of a bustling European town square lined with multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and green shutters. Market stalls with umbrellas fill the square, and a large fountain or monument with statues stands in the center. In the background, on a hill, there is a prominent clock tower structure. The printed caption at the top reads in German about Graz and its Hauptplatz with Schlossberg.
